authority.title: Open innovation with a real factory
authority.description: Dutex has real capacity to turn ideas into industrial products with proprietary processes, applied engineering, production scale and certified quality. We are not just a hub: we are an industry.

fit.title: What kind of idea fits?
items: A prototype looking for a manufacturing partner
A solution for steel, plastics or manufacturing
A product for logistics or transportation
An application for agribusiness or construction
A real market pain point with a clear solution

flow.title: You submit. Dutex evaluates.
flow.description: If there is fit and industrial application potential, we move forward to a technical conversation.

steps.title: Step 01
steps.text: You submit your proposal with the problem, solution and current stage.

steps.title: Step 02
steps.text: The Dutex team evaluates fit with our industrial profile.

steps.title: Step 03
steps.text: If it makes sense, we contact you for a deeper technical discussion.

items.question: Who can submit an idea to Dutex Conecta?
items.answer: Professionals, companies, inventors and teams with industrially applicable ideas can submit proposals for review.

items.question: Does submission guarantee a partnership with Dutex?
items.answer: No. Submission starts a technical screening process. Progress depends on industrial fit, feasibility and mutual interest.

items.question: What kind of ideas usually have stronger fit?
items.answer: Ideas with practical application in manufacturing, logistics, industrial protection, steel, polymers and process improvement usually have higher fit potential.
